caption: Helpoort, Maastricht
composition: Coal-sandstone gate with two round towers and a city wall · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Helpoort stands at the south edge of the old city: grey-brown coal sandstone, two semicircular towers with slate conical roofs, and a narrow passage between them. A stretch of city wall runs toward a smaller round tower. The sky is clear, about 14.5°C, with wind near 11.5 km/h, and a bright moon is up. Vrijthof and Saint Servatius are not in this frame.
